name: Sid Chang
source:
Sid just move to the same department building were [url=https://vndb.org/c151342]Ronnie[/url] lives now, and it seems they are very good friends, a very close friend if you ask me.

As strange as it may sound, it looks like she just flirted with me during the videocall when I met her, but I guess it was just to mess with Ronnie, nothing to worry about...
